confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Bali tourist-hub prices, not live listings or current menus. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately confident. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July is peak dry-season demand in Canggu. Cocktail and wine were set at roughly 2.3 times the beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. FX: the RBA rate was taken from search result summaries that cite rba.gov.au; the RBA data file itself was not opened, so verify the value against the RBA table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast Asian tourist-hub pricing for Bali's Canggu and Ubud area, with ordinary local warungs and cafés as the reference for food and drink, and mid-range Canggu restaurants and guesthouses for the higher tiers.
